description:
Sabbath day do's and don't with Pastor Mark Finley. While some people are confused, others just don't care. The Sabbath which was instituted at creation before sin is not only for literal Jews. It is also for those of us who are under the New Covenant (Spiritual Jews). It's a very special day and you are missing out on a blessing if you don't keep it. In this video Pastor Mark will focus on what principles guide how to keep the Sabbath holy.
